transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Since my in-laws moved into our house, I’ve been constantly keyed up and exhausted. I’m snapping at my wife, putting off calls I’d normally handle right away, and I nearly let a musician’s contract fall apart because I just couldn’t think straight.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About a month now—basically since my in-laws moved into the house.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?
I’m not sure I’d say I’ve lost interest in things, exactly. I just feel so preoccupied lately that I haven’t really had the space for much else.
Aside from feeling keyed up and preoccupied, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
I wouldn’t say I’ve been persistently sad or hopeless. Mostly I feel wound up and distracted by everything going on.
